data.boundary: One impressive response is not overall reliability. Model graders can be wrong; keep evaluation cases separate from tuning examples.
data.agentPrompt: Prepare redacted representative requests and known failures with clear correctness, format and refusal criteria. Preserve model and prompt versions plus raw outputs, distinguishing automated judgments from human review.
